title: Box Cake Cookies
description: This recipe makes cookies from any 15.25 oz (432 g) box of cake mix.

ingredients.text: 2 large eggs, approximately 100 g without shells
1/2 cup oil / approximately 120 g; avocado oil works well

instructions.text: Mix the cake mix, eggs, and oil until combined.
Scoop the dough onto a lined baking sheet. Cookie size does not matter too much.
Bake for about 8-10 minutes, turning the tray halfway through baking.
